additional_info.subject: RE: ID0477242-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 P0 312567479/13] Temperature problem outlet 2 CRM:02889001076
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We noticed the errors in our backend when the charging sessions were stopped by the charger the 4
th
of February 2026 between 13:00 PM and 17:00 PM. I send you the photos of the errors attached to this email. You can especially see that there is an error of cable temperature sensor and more than 25 degrees of difference between DC+ and DC- which is why the charging sessions is stopped.
I think there is a problem with the CCS cable of outlet 2. We already had the same errors on other chargers and if we wait too long, there will be one charging session where the cable will be stuck in the vehicle of a customer.
That’s why we have blocked the charging point with our backend since the 6
th
of February, until you do an intervention to change the cable.
Thank you,
Best Regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0477242-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 P0 312567479/13] Temperature problem outlet 2 CRM:03209000177
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0477242
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / P0 312567479/13
Charger ID / Serial No.: 7HSDoi
Charger address/functional location: France
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Cable temp diff
Following the report of the client, multiple charging sessions stopped, because of the temperature difference of the cable. See log:
Please measure on-site and confirm the values by measuring directly on the cables coming from the CCS. If you see the same value, then the CCS is faulty and needs replacement. Otherwise, please measure 1kOhm until you reach the KF12/13
P1 to P2 and N1 to N2
If you get 1kOhm to the StateMonitor, please try replacing the grey connector with a spare one (they have some connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all)
Or replace the StateMonitor
I recommend you to take spare CCS and StateMonitor.
Hereby attached the reference for the CCS cable for this specific charger:
​​​​​​​
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: 0477242 - ID0477242-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 P0 312567479/13] Temperature problem outlet 2 CRM:00296000525
additional_info.body:
Bonjour Yacine,
Après analyse de la situation et au regard des constats effectués, nous considérons que les défauts évoqués relèvent d’un phénomène d’usure normale, inhérent à l’utilisation intensive des câbles de recharge dans le cadre d’un usage autoroutier. Ces conditions d’exploitation, particulièrement exigeantes, entraînent mécaniquement une sollicitation accrue des câbles, qui ne saurait être assimilée à un défaut de conformité relevant de la garantie contractuelle.
En conséquence, Siemens ne peut accepter la prise en charge du remplacement de ces câbles au titre de la garantie commerciale prévue aux CPA.
Cordialement,
